raw_segments.text: Olivia, give me leave beseech you. I did send, after the last enchantment you did hear,
a ring in chase of you. So did I abuse myself, my servant, and I fear me, you. Under your
hard construction must I sit, to force that on you in a shameful cunning which you knew
none of yours. What might you think? Have you not set mine honor at the stake, and baited
it with all T.H., unmuzzled thoughts that Tyranus' heart can think? To one of your
receiving enough is shown. A cypress, not a bosom, hides my heart. So
